newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures stick sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures stick sharply higher.

text.p: April 29 - U.S. stock index futures stuck at sharply higher levels, just below day's peaks. Action slowed, with support stemming from continued strength in T-bond futures. June S&P 500s face resistance near 793.50 congestion area. Intraday support near 789.00 and 785.20, last Thursday's high. They said Fed's Greenspan remarks had scant impact.
